Stage 1: data_validation; work sample 0.
Implement evaluate(request, policy). Validate every row in input order, with at most one error per row. id must be a nonempty string. amount must be a finite nonnegative number, not bool. Unit defaults to base_unit and must be in policy.units. If policy.unique, reject IDs already accepted from an earlier row. Add an ID to the seen set only after that row passes every check. Error priority is id, amount, unit, duplicate. Return {ok, records, errors}; each error has exactly {row:index,cause}. Each accepted record has exactly {id:the_original_id,amount:the_input_amount_times_policy.units[unit]}. Do not include unit or other metadata in records. Any error makes the complete batch fail with records=[]; still collect errors for all rows. Otherwise ok=true and errors=[]. Do not modify inputs.
Every result must follow OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json. Output objects have exactly the listed fields. Unknown research results have value=null and sources=[]. Use the API arguments supplied by the caller, including earlier policies and evidence; do not substitute current file globals. Write work.py with this API. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. Store findings and unresolved limits for the next agent.

import copy, json
from work import evaluate
p={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}
cases=[
({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':300,'unit':'cm'}]}, {'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':3.0}],'errors':[]}),
({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':4,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),
({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'y','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'z','amount':-0.1}]}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]}),
({'rows':[{'id':'q','amount':-1},{'id':'q','amount':2}]}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'}]})]
for i,(req,expected) in enumerate(cases):
 before=copy.deepcopy(req); got=evaluate(req,p); assert got==expected,(i,got,expected); assert req==before
print(json.dumps({'passed':len(cases),'observations':[evaluate({'rows':[]},p),evaluate({'rows':[{'id':'k','amount':0,'unit':'cm'}]},p)]}))

import copy,json,math
from work import evaluate
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
probes=[
 ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':False},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}],'errors':[]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':0,'amount':False,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'x','amount':False,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'y','amount':1,'unit':'bad'}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':True},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'}]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':-1},{'id':'x','amount':2},{'id':'x','amount':3}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':True},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),
 ({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':1},{'id':'z','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'n','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'v','amount':0}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':2},'unique':False},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]})
]
for i,(req,pol,want) in enumerate(probes):
 rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol)
 assert got==want,(i,got,want); assert req==rb and pol==pb
 assert set(got)=={'ok','records','errors'}
 for rec in got['records']: assert set(rec)=={'id','amount'}
 for err in got['errors']: assert set(err)=={'row','cause'}
print(json.dumps({'report_matches':True,'boundary_probes':len(probes),'sample_result':report[0]}))
